CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_assign_prediction_rule()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_consensus_settings where activated_at<=clock_timestamp()) then return new;end if;
 insert into public.nothingsports_prediction_rules(event_id,version)
 values(new.event_id,case when new.starts_at>clock_timestamp() and exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_consensus_settings where activated_at<=clock_timestamp())
 and not exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_predictions where event_id=new.event_id)
 then 'consensus.v1' else 'anticipation.v2' end) on conflict do nothing;
 if new.status in('completed','finished','final','cancelled','canceled','abandoned') then
  update public.nothingsports_prediction_rules set completed_at=coalesce(new.ends_at,clock_timestamp()),cutoff=coalesce(new.ends_at,clock_timestamp())+interval '48 hours'
  where event_id=new.event_id and completed_at is null and version='consensus.v1';
 end if;
 return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_nsc_record_rating_history()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='INSERT' or new.rating is distinct from old.rating or new.updated_at is distinct from old.updated_at then
 insert into public.nothingsports_nsc_rating_history(user_id,event_id,phase,rating,recorded_at) values(new.user_id,new.event_id,new.phase,new.rating,new.updated_at);
 end if;return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.nothingsports_nsc_record_scoring_version()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.scoring_version='votes.v1' and new.maximum_points is null then
    new.maximum_points:=case new.phase when 'heat' then 8 when 'pulse' then 2 when 'impact' then 2 end;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nothingsports_recovery.alias_guard_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ begin new.event_id := nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(new.event_id); if tg_table_name='nothingsports_nsc_points' and tg_op='INSERT' then if exists(select 1 from public.nothingsports_nsc_points p where p.user_id=new.user_id and nothingsports_recovery.fixture_alias_v1(p.event_id)=new.event_id and p.action_key=new.action_key) then return null; end if; end if; -- bledisloe-pending-timing-v1
 if tg_table_name='nothingsports_reminders' and new.event_id='rugby-australia-new-zealand-2026-10-17' then
 if new.dispatched_at is null and new.delivery_started_at is null and new.delivery_mode='match-15' then
 new.starts_at:='2026-10-17T05:00:00Z'::timestamptz;new.remind_at:='2026-10-17T04:45:00Z'::timestamptz;new.schedule_starts_at:=new.starts_at;
 end if;end if;
 return new; end $function$
